schedule_status: Hypothetical common calendars for every market, fixed before the sample. These are sensitivity assumptions, not observed expiry dates or recommendations for actual rolling.
execution_timing: At the beginning of each scheduled holding month. Charge only min(abs(carried), abs(executed)) for same-direction exposure. Ordinary trades cover entries, exits, reversals and net resizing. A source switch supersedes a coincident assumed roll because its full close/open is already booked.
rate_interpretation: 1 or 2 bps per unit of matched continuing notional for the complete close/open; equivalent to 0.5 or 1 bp per leg. Ordinary trades retain their separate 1 or 2 bps one-way rate. These components have distinct rate bases.
adoption: Do not change the production default or claim empirical all-in returns. Contract identifiers, expiry/roll schedules and adjustment lineage are required before adopting a historical roll model. Economic carry and continuous-price adjustments are not added as execution fees.
